title: Start a Company in Ghana
description: Know exactly what to do, in what order, at Ghana's government offices — from biometric identity and ORC incorporation to tax registration and municipal permits.

steps.title: Obtain Ghana Card for Directors & Shareholders
steps.why: The Office of the Registrar of Companies (ORC) and Ghana Revenue Authority (GRA) mandate Ghana Card biometric identity for all company directors, shareholders, and secretaries.
steps.do_this_when: Before starting company name reservation or registration filings.

options.label: National Identification Authority Portal (Citizens)
options.notes: Online registration portal for biometric Ghana Card issuance.

options.label: Non-Citizen Ghana Card Application (Foreign Residents)
options.notes: Foreign Identification Management Systems for non-citizen residents.

steps.title: Check & Reserve Company Name at ORC
steps.why: Confirms your proposed name does not infringe existing trademarks or registered entities under the Companies Act 2019 (Act 992) and reserves it for 30 days.
steps.do_this_when: Once you have selected 2-3 candidate business names and prepared director IDs.

options.label: Company Name Search and Reservation Portal
options.notes: Official portal to check business name availability and reserve it.

steps.title: Submit Business Registration Pack to ORC
steps.why: Formally registers the company entity, registers company regulations and authorized shares, and yields your Certificate of Incorporation.
steps.do_this_when: Immediately after your name reservation is approved.

options.label: Company Registration Form 3 (Private Limited Company)
options.notes: Standard incorporation pack for a private company limited by shares.

options.label: Business Name Registration Form A (Sole Proprietorship)
options.notes: Sole proprietor / individual business name registration.

options.label: Company Registration Form 3B (Company Limited by Guarantee / NGO)
options.notes: Non-profit organisations, charities, and trade associations.

options.label: External Company Registration (Branch Office)
options.notes: Branch office established by an existing foreign entity.

steps.title: File Beneficial Ownership Declaration
steps.why: Mandated by the Companies Act 2019 to disclose natural persons holding 5% or more equity, voting rights, or control, preventing undisclosed shadow ownership.
steps.do_this_when: Filed alongside the incorporation pack at ORC.

options.label: ORC Beneficial Ownership Declaration Filing
options.notes: Official forms repository for Beneficial Ownership declaration documents.

steps.title: Register on GRA Taxpayers Portal
steps.why: Activates company corporate income tax file, confirms company TIN, and links online filing for monthly returns and withholding taxes.
steps.do_this_when: Immediately following receipt of Certificate of Incorporation.

options.label: GRA Taxpayers Portal
options.notes: Self-service portal for company registration, e-returns, and tax assessment.

options.label: GRA TIN Registration
options.notes: Official guidance on company and director Taxpayer Identification Numbers.

steps.title: SSNIT Employer Registration
steps.why: Enrolls the company as an official employer under Act 766 to remit Tier 1 social security contributions for staff.
steps.do_this_when: Before or upon hiring your first paid staff member.

options.label: SSNIT Employer Registration Portal
options.notes: Requirements and registration for new corporate employers.

options.label: SSNIT Employee Enrolment Form (ISS1A)
options.notes: Official enrollment form for workers holding a Ghana Card.

steps.title: GIPC Registration (Foreign Equity Participation)
steps.why: Mandatory under the GIPC Act 2013 (Act 865) for enterprises with foreign shareholding to satisfy minimum equity capital and qualify for expatriate quotas and incentives.
steps.do_this_when: After ORC incorporation if any shareholder or partner is non-Ghanaian.

options.label: GIPC Investment Registration Portal
options.notes: Application portal for foreign investment enterprise registration.

steps.title: Obtain Municipal Business Operating Permit (BOP)
steps.why: Metropolitan, Municipal, and District Assemblies (MMDAs) mandate an annual permit to conduct business from physical premises in their jurisdiction.
steps.do_this_when: Once your physical office, shop, or desk space in Ghana has been secured.

options.label: Accra Metropolitan Assembly Business Operating Permit Guidelines
options.notes: Official permitting guidelines and rate categories for operating in Accra.
